Subject: Galileo - scheduling technical coding probe and debrief plan

Hi Eleanor / Olivia,

Thanks again for coordinating Galileo's process. We’d like to move forward with a 60-minute technical coding probe (ML + systems emphasis) followed by a 20-minute internal debrief. Proposed slots (PDT):

- Mon 2026-06-08 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2026-06-09 13:00–14:00
- Wed 2026-06-10 08:30–09:30 (early)

Can you confirm which of those works for Galileo? If none do, send a couple of alternatives and the candidate's timezone.

A few logistics / asks so we have everything ready:
- Interview platform: CoderPad session (link to follow). Candidate may use any browser; we prefer Chrome.
- Please share the candidate’s preferred editor and whether they can run Python locally; we may provide a small data file.
- We’ll attach the current rubric and debrief template for transparency. Marissa will run the debrief and share the scorecard.

Attachments: galileo_resume.pdf (candidate resume)

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots pending confirmation.

— Logan

Thanks — Tue 6/9 13:00 PDT works for me. A few details from the interviewer side: 

- Format: 60m live coding (half ML conceptual + a systems-driven coding task). We’ll give the candidate 3 small prompts and ask them to focus on one.
- Platform: CoderPad (we’ll use a prepared pad). Link below. Candidate will not need internet access beyond the pad; we can paste a ~200KB JSON fixture directly into the pad.
- Environment: Python 3.10; we sometimes allow numpy/pandas. If the candidate’s laptop is locked down, they can use the integrated pad run (no external installs required).
- Debrief: 20m immediately after the interview with Marissa to capture notes and scores. Please add a 15-minute buffer for overrun.

CoderPad session (reserved): https://coderpad.redwood.ai/session/GP-4531
Interview rubric (attached): tech-screen-rubric.xlsx

— Dev

- CoderPad link (Dev’s reserved session)
- Small fixture pasted into the pad (no downloads required)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Thanks — I’ll run the debrief and use the attached scorecard. Quick notes for the interviewers before the session:

- Please capture: clarity of reasoning, approach to edge cases, performance considerations, and collaboration signals.
- Use the 1–5 scoring on the rubric and add at least two short bullets for each dimension.
- If we see a split decision, escalate to a second reader within the same day.

I also added a one-pager debrief template (attached) to keep notes consistent. See you Tue.
